observations: All five development trials ended BLOCKED; final authoritative integration remained at the input baseline.
Trials 3 and 4 created IMPLEMENT attempts but recorded no IMPLEMENT model-usage phase; attempt counts are not writer inference counts.
Trial 5 recorded planning, specification design, independent critique, implementation, review, a public integration check failure and bounded repair before the deadline.
The public integration check exited 2 during import collection; this is not a measured behavioral-test assertion pass rate.
Recorded failure classifications are control-policy observations; they do not prove the root cause was the model or infrastructure.
The RPC cancellation transport cleanup was fixed outside the frozen v5 build and was not hot-applied to this run.
The final JSONL uses n_attempt=1 for one sealed submission; five same-task development reruns mean this is not pass@1 or a fair product benchmark.
